race.description: Kempsey Macleay Rsl Club Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: JUSTICE AND GRACE (7) makes immediate appeal on debut after winning an 800m trial at Beaumont (Newcastle), and the inside draw with Ben Looker, top-ranked for wins at this track, gives him the right profile to make a winning start. Paul Snowden's debut record is another positive pointer, with 3 wins from 8 starters. SWEET MARLENE (6) has the best recent race form after finishing second at Taree, beaten just over half a length, and her repeated 1000m placings make her a genuine danger despite the long maiden record. TRULY GRAPHIC (4) resumes after a four-month break, having ended last campaign with a Port Macquarie placing, and the earlier Open run at Rosehill gives his form some depth for a race of this nature. STAR OF VEGA (3) struck a bit of trouble at the start from the wide gate with a fading eighth over 1000m at Port Macquarie. Blinkers go on and can run into the minor money.
